title: fix(ui/scripts): check:node-esm-load and check:published-dist build modes run the release's build
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8W3o2SDQXgpRSRQTXHo1oX3)_
Fixes #26860

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`check:node-esm-load` 与 `check:published-dist` 不带 `--no-build` 手跑时,改为在仓根跑发布用的那条 `pnpm build`;两脚本共用同一个构建函数。
- 为什么改:之前一个在 `ui/` 里跑不存在的 `build` 脚本直接崩,另一个构建了含文档站的 128 个任务,读到的不是发布的产物,本地复现 CI 红灯无从对照。
- 风险与回滚:只动 `ui/scripts` 两个工具脚本与其测试,不发布任何包;CI 与发布路径本来就带 `--no-build`,行为不变;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/scripts/check-published-dist-tooling.mjs` 的 `buildWorkspace`;`ui/scripts/check-node-esm-load.mjs` 的构建步骤;`ui/scripts/__tests__/check-published-dist-tooling.test.ts` 钉发布构建的那条用例。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-node-esm-load.test.ts scripts/__tests__/check-published-dist-tooling.test.ts`,预期 89 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `buildWorkspace` (published-dist gate) now runs the **release's own build**: the workspace root's `build` script, run from the workspace root (`workspaceRoot()` from `ui/scripts/workspace-root.mjs`). `--concurrency` / `--force` are appended and pnpm hands them to turbo. A workspace root with no `build` script is refused by name instead of surfacing as pnpm's exit 254.
- `check-node-esm-load.mjs` full mode now calls that same `buildWorkspace` at the workspace root (`--force-build` maps to turbo `--force`), so both gates read one build. `main` takes an injectable `build` seam so a test can read which build it asks for without paying one.
- Stale docblock text refreshed: both gates said `--no-build` "is wired into nothing" (it is wired into `scripts/release-publish.sh` and ci.yml's `UI Published Artifacts` job), and the published-dist header named `pnpm changeset:publish` as the publish path.

## Why

Shape chosen by measurement, per the card's two options: "what the release builds" is **one stable command**. `pnpm run release` opens with `pnpm run build`; release.yml's `publish` job runs `pnpm run build`; ci.yml's `UI Published Artifacts` job runs `pnpm build` before both gates read with `--no-build`. So the build mode runs that command rather than being removed. Measured on `5e99bd93`: the old published-dist build (`turbo run build --filter=!@object-ui/site` from `ui/`) planned 128 tasks including `@objectstack/docs`; root `pnpm build` plans 127 tasks, neither docs nor site, 41 of them `@object-ui/*`.

The publish path is unchanged: `scripts/release-publish.sh` and ci.yml both pass `--no-build`, so neither builds through this code.

## Tests

- `check-published-dist-tooling.test.ts`: `buildWorkspace` runs `pnpm build` with `cwd` at the given workspace root; forwards `--concurrency=2 --force`; refuses a manifest with no `build` script (naming the manifest, without exec); still throws when the build fails; and a pin that the workspace root's `build` script is what `pnpm run release` opens with and what release.yml's `publish` job runs.
- `check-node-esm-load.test.ts`: `main(['--force-build'])` asks the injected build for `workspaceRoot(ui root)` with `force: true`.
- Both files: 89/89 pass. No ablation: the diff is tooling scripts only (os-dev: scripts are not ablated).

## Acceptance notes

- `ui/package.json` `changeset:publish` still runs the published-dist gate without `--no-build`; after this PR it would build the release's build too. Nothing in the repository invokes it (the release publishes through `scripts/release-publish.sh`), and the `wiring` test's comment still calls it "the command changesets/action runs". Left as is: out of this card's scope.
- Follow-up owed: `.github/workflows/release.yml`'s comment over the publish step is stale in the way the card names (governed, Tier H; not edited here).

## Verification

All on head `cf75e342`, in a fresh worktree, under the shared verify lock (shared-box seconds).

<details><summary>Acceptance: both aliases by hand, exit 0</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui run check:node-esm-load --force-build` → exit 0. turbo: 116 successful, 0 cached. Provenance leg: 35 of 35 gradable entries built by this tree. Load leg: 33 of 36 published ESM entries imported and evaluated (plugin-dashboard and plugin-map by ruling; one bin-only CLI).
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:published-dist` → exit 0. turbo: 116 cached of 116 (this tree's own forced build). "Inspected 36 published package(s): 5813 tarball file(s), 5668 of them build output, 0 tooling artifact(s) in build output."
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:node-esm-load` → exit 0. Provenance 35 of 35 own; load 33 of 36.
- Before the fix (`5e99bd93`): `check:node-esm-load` exit 1, `ERR_PNPM_RECURSIVE_EXEC_FIRST_FAIL Command "build" not found`.
</details>

<details><summary>Counter-probes, one per script (restored and re-run green)</summary>

- published-dist: a test file copied into `ui/packages/core/dist/probe-copied.test.js`, then `check:published-dist --no-build` → exit 1, `@object-ui/core [tooling-in-published-output] packages/core/dist/probe-copied.test.js`. Removed → exit 0.
- node-esm-load: an extensionless relative re-export (`export * from './probe-extensionless'`) appended to `ui/packages/core/dist/index.js`, then `check:node-esm-load --no-build` → exit 1, `@object-ui/core: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` (and its dependants, attributed via `@object-ui/core`). Restored by hash → exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

`dispatch-gates --commands` derived 18 families; all 18 exit 0, reconciled with `--ran` (0 NOT-MEASURED). Includes `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (178 files passed, 2 skipped; 5069 tests passed). Also run: `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`, ui eslint on the four changed files, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:spec-symbols`, all exit 0.
</details>

No changeset: `ui/scripts` ships in no package (`skip-changeset`).
